title: 第14章 信任
content_zh:
“陆都头果然厉害。”
李瑕说着，转身踱了几步，再次看向逍遥湖的水面，缓缓道：“如果是这样，那你不是只要审问这个人就好吗？”
陆凤台两步跟上，与李瑕并肩而站，侧头看着他的神情，问道：“你不吃惊吗？”
李瑕道：“确实没有很吃惊，我之前就做过猜想，认为有这种可能。”
“被我捉住这个人名叫杨雄，乃高氏部将。”陆凤台道：“他们从北面逃过来之后，是杨雄先进城安置，我的人只在最开始与他接触时打探出来一点消息，这伙高氏余部的头领乃大理高泰祥的侄子，高长寿。”
“高长寿。”李瑕轻声念叨了一句，把这名字记下。
“是，高长寿之父叫高泰禾，蒙军攻入大理国时，高秦禾领军在丽江九河与蒙军决战，战败殉国。九河之战据说十分惨烈，我大宋曾派使团往大理吊唁，想必高长寿就是那时与我朝某些重臣有所联络，才有了今日之事。”
“原来陆都头知道这些事，你不是对聂仲由说不了解大理之事吗？”
“正是知道，我才认为大理国之事已不可挽回。段氏丧胆投降、高氏几乎族灭，凭几个漏网之鱼能做什么？何况我朝立志收复汉唐疆域，大理却非汉唐故土，与我朝有何相干？你与之辈，无非只是想利用我们罢了。”
李瑕点点头，又问道：“杨雄还招了什么？”
“他什么都没招。”陆凤台道：“我的人刚套出高长寿的名字，就被杨雄识破了，我们只好把他拿下，但这家伙是个硬骨头，怎样都不肯招。若不是你说，我甚至都不知道在逃的人有几个。”
“如此说来，我倒是有个办法可以找到剩下那四人。”
“什么办法？”
“放长线，钓大鱼。”李瑕道：“可派人假意救出杨雄，与高长寿等人联络，再一网打尽。”
陆凤台又盯着李瑕，没有说话。
李瑕再次从怀里拿出那枚铜牌，道：“我不是说让我来做，你可以拿走这枚铜牌去办这件事，就当我的任务已经完成了。给我安排一个好出路，这事对我而言就到此为止也好。”
陆凤台还是没有拿走铜牌，而是道：“这个办法不是说起来这么简单，不仅要取信杨雄，还得取信高长寿。万一露出一点破绽，杨雄得到机会自尽，我就前功尽弃了。”
“好吧。”
“令牌你收着，免的聂仲由起疑。”
李瑕道：“那也对。”

陆凤台又道：“若要用这个的计划，你是最好的人选。高长寿很可能在暗中观察，他也许已经看到你们进城，看到聂仲由被监视，还看到今天街上那场闹剧……那就只有你最容易获得他们的信任。”
李瑕道：“但你未必信得过我，如果换位而处，我也很难做到让你去办这件事。”
“我不是信不过你。”陆凤台道：“只是我要考虑一下，总之此事还是慎重为好。”
“你考虑。”
“明日再联系。”
李瑕道：“对了，事成之后，我会在庐州城有处宅子吗？能洗澡换衣服那种，你看，我都馊了。”
陆凤台笑道：“放心，会有的……”
次日，天蒙蒙亮时，陆凤台再次坐在了茶楼上。
他饮了清晨第一杯茶水，余光落处，见远远那客院中李瑕做了几个伸展的动作，再次出门晨跑。
李瑕走后，客院中又有一个商队护卫出来活动了一会，走出了客栈。
不多时，这个商队护卫被带上茶楼。
“陆都头好雅兴。”
“你出来不会被聂仲由怀疑吧？”
“我和同伴说是出来买早食的。”
陆凤台又道：“我有几句话问你，你实话实说。”
“陆都头放心，这次我混进这支北上的队伍时上头就交代过，但凡是破坏和议之事，就不能任他们胡作非为。”
“那就好，我问你，昨夜李瑕回到客栈后和聂仲由说了什么？”
“聂仲由问李瑕去了哪里，李瑕说出去逛了逛。聂又问他有什么结果，李瑕说那些人也太小心了，聂叹了口气。”
“夜里呢？”陆凤台问道：“他们又说什么了？”
“客栈中有人退房了，空了几间屋子出来，李瑕要了一间单独的房间，整夜未与聂说过话。”

“你认为，这两人之间互相信任吗？”
“没看出信任，在渡过长江之前李瑕都是被铐着的，只在蒋兴死后才受到聂的重用，但他们并没什么交情，聂还暗中吩咐过林子要看好李瑕……”
陆凤台与这人说完话，又坐了一会，看着远处那客栈里人进人出。
直到冯胜走过来，道：“问过了，白毛鼠说的也一样，李瑕回了客栈后，确实只和聂仲由说了那几句话。”
“白毛鼠是怎么评价李瑕和聂仲由的交情？”
“说是，聂仲由就只会扣人父母威胁逼迫，值得谁替他卖命？”
冯胜说完，又道：“对了，刚才聂仲由起来，似是病了，找了封妙手去给他看病。”
陆凤台偏了偏头，眼神一凝，沉思了好一会，恍然一笑，自语道：“原来如此，我说呢，他这种人，为何会把事情交给李瑕来办……”
“都头？”
“李瑕人在那里？”
“樊三正带人跟着。”
“让李瑕去肥楼见我，注意，告诉他的时候别被人看到……”
肥楼是庐州城内的酒楼。
陆凤台先是到二楼雅间见了樊三。
“李瑕今天在做了什么？”
“他到了城东的木器铺，订做了一些东西。”
“木器铺？”
樊三道：“是，我问过那木匠，李瑕要订做一个大澡盆，下面留一个孔用来放水，上面留两个槽引水，一个是热水槽，一个是凉水槽……”
陆凤路对这些琐事也不厌其烦地听着。
过了一会，李瑕避开旁人，进到了雅间。

陆凤台指了指满桌丰盛的菜肴，道：“知你喜欢吃肉和菜，特地点了肥楼最有名的炙羊肉。”
李瑕也不客气，大大方方落了座，拿起筷子便吃。
陆凤台道：“聂仲由并不信任你，看起来，他好像是把联络高长寿之事交给了你，还布置了聂平掩护你，但实则，此事他是打算自己办。”
“他自己办？联络的信物都在我这里，他怎么自己办？”
“但高长寿并没有因为那令牌来联络你啊。”陆凤台道：“说明高长寿是聪明人，看到你拿出令牌，一定会去查你的背景，到时聂仲由就可以独自联络他。”
“你怎么知道？”
“聂仲由今天见了城内的一个郎中，名叫封妙手，此人以前是我们的军大夫。明白了吗？他只是用你来混淆视线，他唯一信任的只有他自己。”
李瑕道：“可惜，还是你计高一筹。他再想找封妙手，你就猜透了他。”
“不是我高明，只因我是地头蛇罢了。”陆凤台感慨道。
他有些遗憾，遗憾聂仲由身边始终避不开议和派的眼线，但这次立场不同，他也没办法。
陆凤台又道：“我与聂仲由不同的是，我更能信任别人。”
李瑕已夹了最后一块炙羊肉，细嚼慢咽地吃完，漱了口，抹了抹嘴，这才道：“陆都头待人确实比聂仲由更好。”
“吃完了？”
“吃完了，谢谢。”
“我带你去见杨雄。”陆凤台道：“我们按你的计划来做，放长线，钓大鱼。”
“你信我？”
陆凤台点点头，很诚恳地说道：“我说过，我很欣赏你，也信任你……”
content_en:
"Lu Dutou is really awesome."
Li Xia said, turned around, walked a few steps, looked at the water of Xiaoyao Lake again, and said slowly: "If that's the case, don't you just need to interrogate this person?"
Lu Fengtai followed up in two steps and stood side by side with Li Xia. He looked sideways at his expression and asked, "Aren't you surprised?"
Li Xia said: "I'm really not surprised. I have made conjectures before and thought it was possible."
"The name of the man I captured is Yang Xiong, and he is a general of the Gao clan." Lu Fengtai said: "After they escaped from the north, it was Yang Xiong who settled in the city first. My people only found out a little bit of information when they first came into contact with him. The leader of the remaining Gao clan is the nephew of Gao Taixiang of Dali, Gao Changshou."
"Gao Changshou." Li Xia muttered softly and wrote down the name.
"Yes, Gao Changshou's father is called Gao Taihe. When the Mongolian army invaded the Dali Kingdom, Gao Qinhe led his army to fight the Mongolian army in Jiuhe, Lijiang, and was defeated and died for his country. The battle of Jiuhe is said to be very tragic. The Song Dynasty sent a delegation to Dali to express condolences. It must be that Gao Changshou had contact with some important ministers of our dynasty at that time, which led to what happened today."
"So Lu Dutou knows these things. Didn't you tell Nie Zhongyu that you don't understand Dali?"
"It is precisely because of this knowledge that I think the situation in Dali is irreversible. The Duan family surrendered in fear and the Gao family was almost wiped out. What can a few fish slip through the net do? What's more, our dynasty is determined to regain the territory of the Han and Tang Dynasties, but Dali is not the homeland of the Han and Tang dynasties. What does it have to do with our dynasty? You and others just want to use us."
Li Xia nodded and asked, "What else did Yang Xiong recruit?"
"He didn't recruit anything." Lu Fengtai said: "As soon as my man came up with Gao Changshou's name, Yang Xiong saw through it. We had to take him down, but this guy is a tough guy and refused to recruit anyone. If you hadn't said it, I wouldn't even know how many people were at large."
"That being said, I do have a way to find the remaining four people."
"What can I do?"
"Put a long line to catch big fish." Li Xia said: "You can send someone to pretend to rescue Yang Xiong, contact Gao Changshou and others, and then catch them all."
Lu Fengtai stared at Li Xia again and said nothing.
Li Xia took out the bronze medal from his arms again and said, "I'm not saying let me do it. You can take this bronze medal and do this, and treat it as if my task has been completed. Arrange a good way out for me, and this matter will end here for me."
Lu Fengtai still did not take away the bronze medal, but said: "This method is not as simple as it sounds. Not only must we win the trust of Yang Xiong, we must also win the trust of Gao Changshou. If there is any flaw and Yang Xiong gets the opportunity to commit suicide, all my efforts will be in vain."
"Okay."
"Keep the token so that Nie Zhongyu doesn't get suspicious."
Li Xia said: "That's right."
Lu Fengtai added: "If we want to use this plan, you are the best candidate. Gao Changshou is probably observing secretly. He may have seen you entering the city, seeing Nie Zhongyou being monitored, and seeing the farce on the street today... Then only you can easily gain their trust."
Li Xia said: "But you may not trust me. If I were in another position, it would be difficult for me to let you do this."
"It's not that I can't trust you." Lu Fengtai said, "It's just that I have to think about it. In short, it's better to be cautious about this matter."
"You think about it."
"I'll contact you tomorrow."
Li Xia said: "By the way, after this is done, will I have a house in Luzhou City? One where I can take a bath and change clothes. You see, I'm already rotten."
Lu Fengtai smiled and said: "Don't worry, it will happen..."
The next day, when the sky was dark, Lu Fengtai sat in the teahouse again.
He drank the first cup of tea in the morning, and out of the corner of his eye, he saw Li Xia in the guest house in the distance doing a few stretching movements and going out for a morning jog again.
After Li Xia left, another caravan guard came out to move around for a while and walked out of the inn.
Not long after, this businessmanThe team guards were taken to the teahouse.
"Lu Dutou is so elegant."
"You won't be suspected by Nie Zhongyou when you come out, right?"
"My companion and I said we were out to buy breakfast."
Lu Fengtai added: "I have a few questions to ask you. Tell the truth."
"Don't worry, Lu Dutou. I was told by my superiors when I sneaked into the northbound team this time that they cannot be allowed to do whatever they want to do to undermine the peace talks."
"That's good. Let me ask you, what did Li Xia say to Nie Zhongyou when he returned to the inn last night?"
"Nie Zhongyou asked Li Xia where he went, and Li Xia said he went out for a walk. Nie asked him what the result was, and Li Xia said those people were too careful. Nie sighed."
"What about at night?" Lu Fengtai asked, "What did they say again?"
"Someone checked out of the inn and left a few rooms. Li Xia asked for a separate room and didn't speak to Nie all night."
"Do you think these two trust each other?"
"I don't see the trust. Li Xia was handcuffed before crossing the Yangtze River. He was only reused by Nie after Jiang Xing's death. However, they have no friendship. Nie also secretly told Lin Zi to keep an eye on Li Xia..."
After Lu Fengtai finished talking to this man, he sat for a while and watched people coming and going in the inn in the distance.
Until Feng Sheng came over and said, "I asked, and the white-haired rat said the same thing. After Li Xia returned to the inn, he indeed only said those few words to Nie Zhongyou."
"What does the white-haired rat think of the friendship between Li Xia and Nie Zhongyou?"
"Say yes, Nie Zhongyou will only kidnap parents and threaten to force him. Who is worth risking his life for him?"
After Feng Sheng finished speaking, he added: "By the way, Nie Zhongyou got up just now and seemed to be ill. He asked Feng Miaoshou to see him."
Lu Fengtai tilted his head, his eyes were focused, he thought for a long time, suddenly smiled, and said to himself: "That's it, let me tell you, why would a person like him leave things to Li Xia..."
"Tou?"
"Where is Li Xia?"
"Fan San is leading his men to follow."
"Ask Li Xia to meet me at Feilou. Be careful not to be seen when you tell him..."
Feilou is a restaurant in Luzhou City.
Lu Fengtai first went to the private room on the second floor to meet Fan San.
"What did Li Xia do today?"
"He went to the carpentry shop in the east of the city and ordered some things."
"Carpentry shop?"
Fan San said: "Yes, I asked the carpenter that Li Xia wants to order a large bathtub, with a hole underneath for water, and two slots above for water, one for hot water and one for cold water..."
Lu Fenglu listened tirelessly to these trivial matters.
After a while, Li Xia avoided others and entered the private room.
Lu Fengtai pointed at the sumptuous dishes on the table and said, "I know you like meat and vegetables, so I specially ordered Feilou's most famous roasted mutton."
Li Xia was not polite, sat down gracefully, picked up chopsticks and started eating.
Lu Fengtai said: "Nie Zhongyou doesn't trust you. It seems that he has left the matter of contacting Gao Changshou to you and arranged for Nie Ping to cover you. But in fact, he plans to handle this matter himself."
"He does it by himself? I have all the tokens of contact with him, so how can he do it by himself?"
"But Gao Changshou didn't contact you because of the token." Lu Fengtai said: "It shows that Gao Changshou is a smart man. When he sees you taking out the token, he will definitely check your background. Then Nie Zhongyu can contact him alone."
"How do you know?"
"Nie Zhongyou met a doctor in the city today, named Feng Miaoshou. This man used to be our military doctor. Do you understand? He just used you to confuse his vision. The only person he trusts is himself."
Li Xia said: "Unfortunately, you still have the upper hand. If he wants to find Feng Miaoshou again, you will guess him."
"It's not that I'm smart, it's just that I'm a local snake." Lu Fengtai said with emotion.
He had some regrets, regretting that Nie Zhongyou could never avoid the spy of the peace negotiators, but this time his stance was different and there was nothing he could do about it.
Lu FengtaiHe added: "The difference between me and Nie Zhongyou is that I can trust others more."
Li Xia had picked up the last piece of roasted mutton, chewed it slowly, rinsed his mouth, wiped his mouth, and then said: "Lu Dutou really treats people better than Nie Zhongyu."
"Have you finished eating?"
"I've finished eating, thank you."
"I'll take you to see Yang Xiong." Lu Fengtai said, "We will follow your plan and take a long-term approach to catch big fish."
"Do you believe me?"
Lu Fengtai nodded and said sincerely: "I said that I admire you very much and trust you..."
